outputs.discrepancies: Caption states the western blot was performed 'with anti-ubiquitin antibody' to confirm similar aggregate formation, but the panel also includes an additional immunoblot for 1C2 (an antibody recognizing expanded polyglutamine) and an αTubulin loading control, neither of which is mentioned or explained in the caption.

Caption describes rotarod performance details for 'three genotypes of mice (WT, Atxn1-KI and double-transgenic)', but the panel actually plots four genotypes, including an additional HMGB1-only transgenic group not mentioned in the caption.
